entries.claim: A /seldon prd rerun that stops to ask the user a question can never finish. The answer turn reaches the PRD draft through "PRD questions answered", not through the step name, so §13's guard sends it to the later-release line and the PRD is never updated.
entries.failure_scenario: Setup: brief.md and prd.md are both on disk, and the brief has since gained something only the user can decide. The user runs `/seldon prd`. §1 routes it to the PRD rerun, and §12 (lines 421-423), which the rerun runs under, says to ask every open question in one message and write nothing. The user replies `/seldon <answer>`. That argument isn't a step name, so §1 takes the "PRD questions answered" route (line 102): "Go to 'The PRD draft' and draft with those answers." §13 says the `/seldon prd` rerun is "the only route into the PRD step that updates a PRD that's there" (443-444) and that "Every other route that reaches this step and finds prd.md writes nothing and ends on the later-release line" (450-451). So the turn drops the user's answers, leaves prd.md unchanged and ends with "The spine and epics steps come in a later release, so I've written nothing this time." The rerun the plan promises (FLOW-03/D-09) never happens. Neither the continuation route nor the guard's exception list allows a rerun to carry over into its question-answer turn.
